pro_course_detail.title: Reach for English! A Fun, Interactive Course to Build Reading, Speaking, & Writing Skills
pro_course_detail.description:
*This course is geared toward children ages 4 - 12. *

What will I learn in this course?
Reach for English is a course designed in collaboration with National Geographic Learning. It is a fun, interactive course with 3 Main Emphases: Reading, Speaking, & Writing. The lessons are all based on picture book stories, focusing on the development of reading skills. We will build English skills by focusing on phonics, grammar, spelling, listening & speaking comprehension, and oral writing.

What happens during a lesson?
In an individual class, we will begin with a Warm-Up to help students get into “English Mode.” We will also discuss the goals for today’s lesson and introduce the lesson topic. We will follow up with review when applicable, introduce new vocabulary and grammar, and play practise games. Together, we will read a story and practise discussion skills by asking and answering questions about the story as we read. We will end our lesson by writing sentences about the story using our new vocabulary.

How long is this course?
Each Course is 30 lessons long and may be purchased by individual lesson or in 10-course increments. 

What level is this course?
This course is accessible to Levels PREK - G4A. 

How is my progress?
I provide written feedback after every fifth lesson. This personalised report will provide a constructive, encouraging review of your listening and speaking skills, classroom engagement, foundational skills, and reading & oral writing skills. 

Can I review lessons after class?
Yes! All lessons are recorded independently by me and will be forwarded to the client after each session. Recordings are to ensure continued quality. Student information remains private.

What materials do you provide for each lesson?
Prior to each lesson, I provide relevant student enrichment materials such as practise book pages and videos. I do not require a student to have reviewed or completed these materials prior to the lesson.

pro_course_detail.title: Reading Tree - Learn English Through the Adventures of Kipper, Chip, Biff & More!
pro_course_detail.description:
*This course is geared toward children ages 4 - 12. *

What will I learn in this course?
Reading Tree is a course designed by Oxford University Press around the Oxford Reading Tree series. This course is designed to facilitate the development of essential English skills for effective learning through reading while helping learners become independent readers. In each lesson, we will build English skills by focusing on reading strategies & skills, vocabulary, speaking, fluency, phonics & phonological awareness, and writing.

What happens during a lesson?
In an individual class, we will begin with a Warm-Up to help students get into “English Mode.” We will also discuss the goals for that lesson and introduce the lesson topic. We will follow up with review when applicable, learn phonics, and improve pronunciation. Together, we will read a story and discuss it, building comprehension, vocabulary, and accuracy. Afterwards, we will practise retelling the story, practise free talk using new vocabulary, and practise oral writing.

How long is this course?
Each Course is 30 lessons long and may be purchased by individual lesson or in 10-course increments. 

What level is this course?
This course is accessible to Levels PREK - G2B. 

How is my progress?
I provide written feedback after every fifth lesson. This personalised report will provide a constructive, encouraging review of your child’s listening and speaking skills, classroom engagement, foundational skills, and reading & oral writing skills. 

Can I review lessons after class?
Yes! All lessons are recorded independently by me and will be forwarded to the client after each session. Recordings are to ensure continued quality. Student information remains private.

What materials do you provide for each lesson?
After each class, I will provide students a PDF copy of the next lesson’s story. While it is not required to read each story prior to a lesson, I highly recommend it!

teacher_info.about_teacher:
As your teacher, my goal is to help you achieve your personal objectives! In our first lesson, we’ll discuss what you want to improve—whether it’s speaking confidently, boosting fluency, or mastering English for your career. Together, we’ll create a fun and effective learning plan just for you.

I’m dedicated to making you feel comfortable speaking English. With positive energy and engaging questions, I’ll encourage you to express yourself freely. I’ve taught students of all ages, from professionals to kids, and I know how to make learning fun!

Finally, I’ll inspire you to keep learning outside our lessons with materials that match your interests. Let’s start this exciting journey together!
teacher_info.teaching_style:
In my lessons, I create a customized learning experience just for you! I use a premium curriculum that covers grammar, reading, writing, speaking, and listening. To keep things fun, I mix in real-world materials, videos, games, and songs that match your interests.

Each lesson is designed to be enjoyable and effective! We’ll explore exciting topics using engaging tools while I help you with pronunciation to sound natural in English. I focus on common challenges from your native language. With fun activities and supportive feedback, you’ll feel more confident speaking English in no time.

Join me for a trial class, and let’s make learning English a fun adventure together!
